results.title: Jackson Olson's Fiancée Maggie Sajak Cheers Him on at 'DWTS' Debut: 'I Am So Excited'
results.description: Maggie Sajak, daughter of Pat Sajak and fiancée of Savannah Bananas player Jackson Olson, expressed her excitement and pride for Olson as he embarks on his journey on Dancing With the Stars. Despite the long distance between them, the couple remains committed to their relationship, cherishing the early stages of their romance. Olson, a lifelong baseball fan and athlete, is thrilled to showcase his passion for dance on the national stage.
